from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The fuzz harness always enables PROXY parsing, so inputs starting with a PROXY header are delivered directly to the vulnerable parser."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":887,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The harness only forwards inputs that already contain a complete request terminator, so the payload must include both a PROXY header and a valid HTTP request tail."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The first bytes are reinterpreted as a PROXY protocol frame before HTTP parsing occurs."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser reads the attacker-chosen version, family, and length fields directly from the input buffer."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (size > sizeof(*hdr)) return NULL;","note":"The fixed-size check admits only small lengths, so the interesting cases are the smallest legal TCP4/TCP6 frames that still shift the HTTP parser state."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":254,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","note":"After a minimal valid frame is accepted, parsing continues from the first HTTP byte following the PROXY block."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":266,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The remaining-region scan uses the shifted pointer and adjusted size; a malformed frame length can make this scan observe bytes outside the intended HTTP request area."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read_text())
PY
